role: declared policy of the response model; beta, ci, weak_strong, ranges, drift and tau are estimated at training and written to artifacts/response_model.json (T112)
horizon_response_source: beta is the mean cumulative ARX response at 3-8 h to a sustained step, so no effect is credited before 3 h (response_onset_hours); within the 3 h case horizon at most 0.66 of beta*dT is credited: the APC delivers 0.62-0.66 of the commanded T6 step by 3 h (FS = 0.66, F1 first stage on SELECT, context/response-research/t6/response_model.py, RESPONSE_MODEL_T6.md section 5); beyond the horizon (look-ahead) the full beta applies
flow_beta_note: F9 lags enter the ARX only as a control; no identified sustained flow effect (F9 vs F26 as flow tag changes beta by <0.002)
